frequency_question: How often do majority party principals successfully push through their core restrictive or prescriptive electoral bills when prioritized?
membership_rule: Includes major federal electoral reform bills championed by party leadership (e.g., H.R. 1 / For the People Act attempts, previous major voting rights pushes). Excludes non-controversial technical amendments or bipartisan compromises.

cases.name: For the People Act (H.R. 1) Senate push 2021
Freedom to Vote Act Senate push 2022

coverage_note: 4 major landmark federal electoral reform legislative pushes examined since 2002.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller rider provisions attached unconditionally to must-pass omnibus spending bills.
skeleton: Major partisan/caucus-backed electoral reform bills advanced by party leadership divided by total major attempts where principals signaled strong intent.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 4 major partisan/bipartisan landmark attempts where leadership prioritized passage in the Senate.
validity_reason: Senate procedural norms like the filibuster remain stable over this medium-term window.
